# Data

LOLA was performed for DM, hyper-, and hypomethylated Cgs different conditions using all Cgs of the normalized data set as the universe.


```{r}
data_storage_folder_cc = "../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm/"
data_storage_folder_pc = "../../../../Data/Processed/PolyclonalCultures/DNAm/"
```

```{r}
all_result_tabs <- list()
```


```{r}
transform_tab <- function(x, study, db , comparison) {
  if(!inherits(x, "data.table")) x <- as.data.table(x)
  x$study <- study
  x$DB <- db
  x$comparison <- comparison
  x$ID = paste0(x$collection, "_", x$description) |> make.unique()
  
  x$OddsRatio <- x$logOddsRatio
  x$logOddsRatio <- log2(x$OddsRatio)

  x$untreated = with(x, !complete.cases(treatment) | treatment == "None" | treatment == "No treatment" | treatment == "regular medium" | treatment == "serum_starved_media" | treatment == "serum_stimulated_media" | treatment == "full media" | treatment == "mock" | treatment == "No treatment(Antibody RAR _A704)" | treatment == "No treatment(Antibody RXR _sc774)" )

  x$comp_direction <- ifelse(grepl("_hyper$",comparison), "Hyper", ifelse(grepl("_hypo$", comparison), "Hypo", "other") )

  x$comp_ID <- paste0(x$study, "__", x$comparison)
  x$collection_ID <- paste0(x$DB, "__", x$collection)
  
  x[, pos_rank := rank(ifelse(p.adj < 0.05, -logOddsRatio, NA)), by="collection_ID"]
  x[, neg_rank := rank(ifelse(p.adj < 0.05, logOddsRatio, NA)), by="collection_ID"]
  x[["qValue"]] <- NULL
  
  return(x)
}
```


```{r}
tmp.env <- new.env()
load(file.path(data_storage_folder_cc, "LOLA_Core_results_baseline_filtered.Rdata"), envir = tmp.env)
tmp <- get("all_results_lola", tmp.env)
tmp <- mapply(FUN = transform_tab, tmp, "CC","LOLA_Core", names(tmp), SIMPLIFY = F)
all_results <- do.call(rbind, tmp)

load(file.path(data_storage_folder_cc, "LOLA_Ext_results_baseline_filtered.Rdata"), envir = tmp.env)
tmp <- get("all_results_lola", tmp.env)
tmp <- mapply(FUN = transform_tab, tmp, "CC","LOLA_Ext", names(tmp), SIMPLIFY = F)
all_results <- rbind(all_results, do.call(rbind, tmp))

load(file.path(data_storage_folder_cc, "LOLA_custom_Hpy_results_baseline_filtered.Rdata"), envir = tmp.env)
tmp <- get("all_results_lola", tmp.env)
tmp <- lapply(tmp, function(x) {x$description <- gsub(".bed", "", gsub("Hpy_infection_primary_","Hpy_", x$filename), fixed = T); x})
tmp <- mapply(FUN = transform_tab, tmp, "CC","Hpy_infection", names(tmp), SIMPLIFY = F)
all_results <- rbind(all_results, do.call(rbind, tmp))

all_result_tabs[["CC"]] <- all_results

```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
for(comp_dir in c("Hyper","Hypo")) {
  for (sc in sel_collections) {
    tmp <- subset(all_results_final, p.adj < 0.2 & 
                     (pos_rank < 10 | neg_rank < 10) &
                     comp_direction == comp_dir & 
                     comp_ID %in% sel_comparisons & 
                     collection_ID == sc)
    if(nrow(tmp) < 1) next

    df <- reshape2::dcast(tmp, collection_ID + DB + collection + label ~ comp_ID, value.var = "logOddsRatio", fun.aggregate = mean)
    df$sig_cnt <- rowSums(as.matrix(!is.na(df[, 5:ncol(df)])))
    
    #tmp <- subset(df, collection_ID == sc & comp_direction == comp_dir & sig_cnt > 1)
    if(nrow(df) < 1) next
    m <- df[, 5:(ncol(df)-1)] |> as.matrix()
    rownames(m) <- df$label
    m[is.infinite(m)] <- sign(m[is.infinite(m)]) * 20
    m2 <- m
    m2[is.na(m2)] <- 0
    row_hclust <- hclust(dist(m2), method="mcquitty")
    breaks <- c(-20,-10,-5,seq(-2,2,by=4/94),5,10,20)
    pheatmap(m, main=paste0(sc, "- ", comp_dir), cluster_cols=F, cluster_rows = row_hclust, breaks=breaks)
  }
}
```
